---
title: Labels on Rows of Multi-Row Equations
format:
  html: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - "a &amp;= 0\\+1 \\\\tag\\{2\\}"
          # row without a label, including the \\ inside the matrix
          - "\\\\end\\{pmatrix\\} &amp;= v \\\\notag"
          - "c &amp;= 4\\+5 \\\\tag\\{3\\}"
          # every label's target wraps the equation (for hover previews)
          - "<span id=\"eq-a\"><span id=\"eq-c\"><span class=\"math display\">"
          - "<a href=\"#eq-a\" class=\"quarto-xref\">Equation&nbsp;2</a>"
          - "<a href=\"#eq-c\" class=\"quarto-xref\">Equation&nbsp;3</a>"
          # numbering continues after the multi-row equation
          - "<a href=\"#eq-after\" class=\"quarto-xref\">Equation&nbsp;4</a>"
        - []
    pdf:
      ensureLatexFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - "a &= 0\\+1 \\\\label\\{eq-a\\}"
          - "\\\\end\\{pmatrix\\} &= v \\\\nonumber"
          - "Equation~\\\\ref\\{eq-a\\}"
          - "Equation~\\\\ref\\{eq-c\\}"
        - []
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - "#link\\(<eq-a>\\)\\[Equation~2\\]"
          - "#link\\(<eq-c>\\)\\[Equation~3\\]"
          - "#counter\\(math\\.equation\\)\\.update\\(n => n \\+ 2\\)"
          # rows are laid out in a grid with the numbers in their own column,
          # set in math to match the font of other equations' numbers
          - "\\[\\], \\$display\\(a\\)\\$, \\$display\\(= 0 \\+ 1\\)\\$, \\[\\], \\[#\\[\\$\"\\(2\\)\"\\$\\]<eq-a>\\]"
        - []
---

Rows of `align`-like environments can be labeled individually with
`\label{eq-...}` and referenced with `@eq-...`
(<https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/2275>).
Labeled rows are numbered in sequence with other equations and unlabeled rows
are left unnumbered, in all formats.

$$
x = 1
$$ {#eq-before}

$$
\begin{align}
a &= 0+1 \label{eq-a} \\
\begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix} &= v \\
c &= 4+5 \label{eq-c}
\end{align}
$$

$$
y = 2
$$ {#eq-after}

See @eq-before, @eq-a, @eq-c and @eq-after.
